text: kevin: Morning all — async standup. Quick SLO / alert follow-ups. kevin: What I did: triaged the 02:00 UTC 503s on redis-proxy, saw an increase in connection resets. Root cause looks like keepalive setting mismatch after the kernel update on a subset of hosts. kevin: Blockers: need someone to validate the canary rollback patch for connection timeout defaults; not comfortable pushing without a second pair of eyes. kevin: Today: will prepare a small hotfix and run it in canary pool, and wire an alert that distinguishes "backend-503" from "client-timeout". maria: Thanks. I reviewed the logs earlier. We saw a spike in RSTs in nginx -> redis-proxy around 02:03 for ~6m, correlates with a flappy host (i-08xx). I marked it in the infra dashboard. sam: I can review the rollback. Ping me the PR when ready. kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/431 — changes tcp_keepalive and retries for redis-proxy. It's small. lee: @oncall-bot scheduled canary rollout at 10:15 UTC. lee: (oncall-bot): Scheduled canary rollout at 10:15 UTC. :rocket: maria: Also flagged that our alert for kv-cache-eviction is too noisy; it's firing for transient increases. Proposed PromQL tweak: sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (cluster) > 5 maria: Suggest switching to increase() and add a 10m window and alert only if it's sustained: sum(increase(kv_cache_evictions_total[10m])) by (cluster) > 20 dave: I can update the alert. Which runbook should we point to? I think runbooks/cache-eviction.md is the doc? kevin: Yes, runbooks/cache-eviction.md — also add a note about checking network MTU mismatch and kernel patch level. sam: Quick question: do we want to fallback to model-variant B when redis proxy fails, or degrade to local L0 cache? kevin: For now degrade to local L0 cache on a per-request basis; model-variant fallback changes output distribution. I'll open an RFC later. maria: I'm going to add a Graf panel for connection_resets by host and annotate the kernel upgrade timeframe. sam: PR LGTM from me, @kevin — minor nit on comment style. kevin: Thanks — @sam can you merge when you're back online? I'll kick the canary after merge. pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-4832 assigned to kevin (escalation: oncall-sre). kevin: Ack — will handle. If canary shows regression, I'll rollback and post results here. lee: FYI — I started a small SLO audit yesterday; preliminary shows 99.95% for p99 latency but we have error budget burn from 5xx that needs investigation. I'll share the spreadsheet. maria: Action items: dave -> update alert query + runbook link; sam -> merge PR; kevin -> deploy canary and monitor; lee -> share SLO audit. kevin: tagging logs snippet for reviewer: 2026-03-16T02:03:12Z redis-proxy[pid=234]: RST from 10.12.34.56: connection reset by peer sam: I'll be offline 11:00-12:00 UTC but can merge before. maria: closing loop — I'll reduce alert noise and add dashboard annotation. :white_check_mark: kevin: closing — thanks all. :thumbsup:
